units.source_text: 那时我心里有点责怪先生。

en.t: At that moment, in my heart, I felt a little resentful toward Sensei.

units.source_text: 我们并肩走起来后，我想问的话也故意不问了。

en.t: After we began walking side by side, I deliberately left unasked the things I had wanted to ask.

units.source_text: 但是，不知先生是否注意到了我的神态，

en.t: But whether Sensei noticed my manner or not,

units.source_text: 仍然像平时那样默默地迈着沉稳的步子走着，好像毫不介意似的。

en.t: he went on walking silently with his usual calm, steady steps, as though he were not concerned at all.

units.source_text: 我有点气恼，忽然想说点什么刺激他一下。

en.t: I became somewhat irritated and suddenly wanted to say something to provoke him.

units.source_text: “先生。”

en.t: "Sensei."

units.source_text: “什么事？”

en.t: "What is it?"

units.source_text: “刚才先生有点兴奋吧，咱们在苗圃园里休息的时候。

en.t: "You were a little excited just now, Sensei, when we were resting in the nursery garden.

units.source_text: 我很少看见先生兴奋，今天可开了眼了。”

en.t: I almost never see you excited, so today was quite an eye-opener."

units.source_text: 先生没有马上回答，令我感觉像是达到了目的，可又好像没有达到，只好悻悻地打住了话头。

en.t: Sensei did not answer at once, which made me feel as if I had achieved my aim, and yet also as if I had not, so I could only stop talking in frustration.

units.source_text: 这时，先生突然向路边走去，在修剪整齐的篱笆边，卷起衣襟开始小解。

en.t: Just then, Sensei suddenly walked to the side of the road, lifted the hem of his robe beside a neatly trimmed hedge, and began to relieve himself.

units.source_text: 先生小解时，我呆呆地站在一旁等着他。

en.t: While Sensei relieved himself, I stood there blankly beside him and waited.

units.source_text: “哦，抱歉。”

en.t: "Ah, excuse me."

units.source_text: 先生说完又走起来。

en.t: After saying this, Sensei started walking again.

units.source_text: 我到底还是放弃了为难先生的念头。

en.t: In the end, I gave up the idea of making things difficult for Sensei.

units.source_text: 我们走的这条路渐渐热闹起来，

en.t: The road we were walking along gradually grew livelier,

units.source_text: 刚才不时看到的开阔的坡田和平地不见了，左右两边都是鳞次栉比的住家。

en.t: and the broad sloping fields and flat open ground we had glimpsed from time to time disappeared, replaced on both sides by closely packed houses.

units.source_text: 但是，在许多住家的院落里，依然能看见缠在竹架上的豌豆藤和用金属网圈养的鸡，

en.t: Even so, in many household yards one could still see pea vines twining around bamboo frames and chickens kept inside wire mesh,

units.source_text: 看着很悠闲，从城里回来的驮马不断从我们身边走过。

en.t: which looked quite peaceful, while packhorses returning from town kept passing by us.

units.source_text: 我一直被这些景象吸引着，刚才堵在心里的疙瘩，早不知掉到哪里去了。

en.t: I remained absorbed in these sights, and the knot that had been lodged in my heart a moment before had long since vanished somewhere.

units.source_text: 当先生突然又提起刚才的话茬时，我早已忘记了。

en.t: When Sensei suddenly brought up the matter from before again, I had already forgotten it.
